_comment: Two routines for the FAMS Support Agent. Create them in the Paperclip UI (Routines > New) or via the API calls in README section 6. Replace <SUPPORT_AGENT_ID>.

create.title: Triage new Freshdesk tickets
create.description: A new Freshdesk ticket was created (or this is the scheduled safety-net sweep). Follow the similar-ticket-triage skill: find new tickets, compare with historical resolved tickets, and email a proposed answer to the reviewer only when there is a strong known solution. The webhook payload (if any) contains the Freshdesk ticket id.

create.title: Refresh historical ticket index
create.description: Run `python3 $SUPPORT_AGENT_HOME/scripts/sync_blob.py` to download any new or changed ticket exports from Azure Blob Storage and rebuild the search index. Comment the JSON summary it prints, then close the issue. Do nothing else.
